Estimate means and standard deviations from medians and quantiles

Source: R/effects.R
convert_median_to_mean.Rd

Fills in mean_<arm> and sd_<arm> where they are missing, using metamedian, from whichever of median, quartiles and range each study reports. Reported means and SDs are never overwritten. The column mean_<arm>_method records whether each value was "reported", estimated ("wan" or "qe"), or could not be estimated (NA).

Usage

convert_median_to_mean(
  data,
  arm = c("int", "ctrl"),
  ...,
  method = c("wan", "qe")
)

Arguments

data

Outcome data frame in the canonical schema.

arm

Arm(s) to fill: "int", "ctrl", or both (the default).

...

Unused; must be empty.

method

"wan" (Hozo/Wan/Bland, via metamedian's "hozo/wan/bland") or "qe" (quantile estimation).

Value

data with the arms' mean, SD and method columns filled in.
